jobs.title: Guild: Rats in the Cellar
jobs.statement: Something has gnawed through the inn’s flour sacks. Noriko Hanesawa offers 30 marks to clear the cellar and stop the damage before supper preparations.
jobs.goal: Clear the rats damaging Roseberry Inn’s cellar stores and close their visible entry gap, leaving the food storage usable.
jobs.scene: Noriko Hanesawa has balanced a flour sack on a chair and is refusing to sacrifice another loaf. Two ordinary rats occupy the cellar, separated by shelving; begin with one exposed and the other hiding. Their trail leads to a loose board beside the steps. Fighting, traps or a food lure can clear them; the gap needs a simple physical repair. Let this be a short, satisfying first job. No rat king, disease outbreak or second nest.

jobs.title: Guild: The Washbasin Is Occupied
jobs.statement: Daichi Kamado’s kitchen basin has acquired an unwelcome wobbling occupant. He offers 30 marks for a working basin and an uninterrupted lunch service.
jobs.goal: Remove or defeat the Puddle Slime in The Golden Ladle’s washbasin and restore the basin to safe use.
jobs.scene: One level 1–2 Puddle Slime keeps sliding back into the basin through a leaking pipe joint. Daichi Kamado argues with it as if it were a lazy kitchen assistant. A bucket, a lure or careful fighting can remove it; closing the small leak prevents another immediate slip back. Splashing dishes makes a mess, not an acid attack. The actual removal and usable basin finish the work.

jobs.title: Guild: The Watchdog Nobody Hired
jobs.statement: A stray dog is defending a bundle of stolen provisions behind the cargo sheds. Kaito Minato offers 35 marks to recover the supplies and let the porters work safely.
jobs.goal: Recover the cargo-pier provisions and end the stray dog’s obstruction without leaving it threatening the workers.
jobs.scene: One hungry level 1–2 dog has decided a dropped sausage bundle is its property. It barks before snapping and backs toward the shed when crowded. Food, calm handling, a barrier or a fight can settle it. Kaito Minato wants the pier safe; he has not ordered a killing or promised free adoption. The dog does not lead to a wolf pack. Keep any voluntary care or ownership decision separate from the paid job.

jobs.title: Guild: Something in the Flour
jobs.statement: Flour sacks are moving by themselves in Brookmeadow’s mill yard. Haruho Taneda offers 35 marks to stop the theft without ruining the remaining grain.
jobs.goal: Remove the Flour Beetle taking grain in Brookmeadow’s Mill Lane and leave the remaining sacks secure.
jobs.scene: One level 1–2 Flour Beetle is hauling a sack far too large for it, inch by determined inch. Haruho Taneda is more offended by the waste than frightened. It pauses to rearrange the load, exposing its soft underside. Trap, lure or defeat it. A tipped sack and a tied store cover are enough environmental business; the beetle is not a secret armored boss.

jobs.title: Guild: Swept Off Your Feet
jobs.statement: A cleaning broom at Rune and Raven’s has begun treating customers’ boots as stubborn dirt. Reiji Takatori offers 35 marks to stop it before another customer complains.
jobs.goal: Safely stop the runaway cleaning broom in Rune and Raven’s back stock and leave it contained or repaired.
jobs.scene: One level 2 broom has chased Reiji Takatori onto a stock stool. Its loose binding charm is plainly accessible near the bristles. Pinning it, distracting it with dirt, disabling the binding or defeating it are all credible. A cracked handle may lower its resale value but does not secretly cancel the agreed fee. No advanced Enchantment skill is mandatory to wrestle a broom into a cupboard.

jobs.title: Guild: A Claw in the Channel
jobs.statement: A large crab has wedged itself into an irrigation sluice. Takumi Hatano offers 40 marks to restore the water before the lower beds dry out.
jobs.goal: Remove the Orchard Crab blocking the agreed irrigation sluice and restore water to the lower beds.
jobs.scene: A single level 2–3 crab grips the sluice frame. Takumi Hatano holds a basket with an obvious hole in it and insists it was a perfectly good plan. The crab raises its claw before a pinch. Bait, a sound container, a lifted gate or careful fighting works. Water should flow again once the obstruction and lodged twigs are removed; do not add an upstream monster.

jobs.title: Guild: A Very Unhelpful Night-Light
jobs.statement: Sooty wing prints are appearing across The Wandering Quill’s clean paper. Shizuru Sumida offers 40 marks to remove the moths and protect the stock.
jobs.goal: Clear the Soot Moths from The Wandering Quill’s stock alcove and remove the lamp residue drawing them to the paper.
jobs.scene: Two level 2–3 moths circle one warm lamp; only one is an active nuisance initially. Shizuru Sumida has covered the costly paper with cheap practice sheets. Their amber wing prints collect nearest a freshly polished lamp: sweet resin in the polish, not cursed ink, attracts them. A shaded decoy, netting or careful blows can clear them. Cleaning that lamp gives the job a small satisfying explanation, not another quest.

jobs.title: Guild: Something Chewed the Joists
jobs.statement: Fresh timber keeps failing Makoto Sashihara’s checks before it reaches the workbench. He offers 60 marks to find and stop whatever is chewing the stored joists.
jobs.goal: Stop the Timberjaw Gnawer damaging the stored joists and help Makoto Sashihara separate sound timber from the gnawed pieces.
jobs.scene: One level 5–8 gnawer nests beneath the damp rack. Paired tooth marks lead to it. A propped timber stack makes reckless heavy attacks a poor choice, but Makoto Sashihara can show a safe brace when asked. Capture, drive off or defeat the creature, then identify the visibly damaged pieces. No hidden infestation or engineering examination follows.

jobs.title: Guild: Lanterns With a Temper
jobs.statement: Rinpei Komatsu’s newest hanging lantern has started buzzing at customers. He offers 65 marks to remove its occupants without scattering them through the arcade.
jobs.goal: Clear the Lantern Wasps from the occupied bazaar lantern and leave the immediate stall frontage safe.
jobs.scene: Two level 6–8 wasps have occupied a hollow display lantern; only one emerges at first. Close the neighboring screens or move the display before provoking both. Rinpei Komatsu claims the buzzing is excellent advertising until a customer refuses to approach. Covering its light, relocating the nest or a controlled fight works. A painful sting is one resolved attack, not an automatic continuing poison clock.

jobs.title: Guild: Warm Feet, Cold Delivery
jobs.statement: A Cinderback Lizard has settled on the forge delivery route. Kazuo Kurogaki offers 70 marks to clear it without letting its ember puffs reach the waiting packing straw.
jobs.goal: Remove the Cinderback Lizard from Blackstone Smithy’s delivery route and make the packed goods safe to move.
jobs.scene: One level 7–9 lizard sprawls across a warm stone near the forge door. Its glowing shoulder scales telegraph each short ember puff. Moving the straw and opening a cool route are useful preparation. Lure it, contain it or fight with the forge’s actual cover. Kazuo Kurogaki provides ordinary tongs when asked, not a free enchanted weapon. The job ends with a clear route and secure packing.

jobs.title: Guild: The Spare Parts Bargain
jobs.statement: Washers, springs and a very particular gear have vanished from Seiji Haguruma’s cabinet. He offers 75 marks for their recovery and an end to the intrusions.
jobs.goal: Recover or replace Seiji Haguruma’s stolen working parts on terms he accepts, and settle the Scrap Imp’s repeated intrusions.
jobs.scene: One level 7–10 Scrap Imp has assembled an almost-working clock beneath the bench. It sincerely offers to trade the stolen gear for another stolen gear. Seiji Haguruma may accept a properly agreed supply of useless offcuts if the necessary working parts come back; the player cannot give his stock away for him. Bargain, trap or defeat the imp. Its ridiculous hobby does not excuse the theft or compel friendship.

jobs.title: Guild: A Ripple Under the Ford
jobs.statement: Something has been snapping at the crossing ropes at Brookmeadow Ford. Shiori Kawase offers 80 marks to make the marked crossing usable again.
jobs.goal: Remove the Reed Ambusher threatening the marked ford crossing and restore a safe line for the crossing crew.
jobs.scene: One level 8–11 ambusher waits beside the shallow rope anchor, with ripples exposing its position. Shiori Kawase refuses to send another porter across until it is dealt with. Work from a dry bank, draw it into the open or fight during its recovery after a leap. A frayed rope needs retying, not a second expedition. The accepted notice makes this stronger creature explicit; ordinary nearby travelers do not acquire its difficulty.

jobs.title: Guild: Prickles in the Orchard
jobs.statement: A Burrback Hedgebeast keeps flattening the orchard fence on its evening visits. Takumi Hatano offers 90 marks to stop the raids and secure the damaged stretch.
jobs.goal: End the Burrback Hedgebeast’s raids on the agreed orchard beds and leave the damaged fence secure.
jobs.scene: One level 8–11 grazer follows the smell of split fruit through a broken fence. Its lowered head and scraping forefoot warn of a charge. Moving the windfalls can draw it away; a sound barrier, relocation or defeat also works. Takumi Hatano can supply fence slats from his actual repair pile. This is a stubborn animal causing costly damage, with no obligation to discover a secret ecological catastrophe.

jobs.title: Guild: Do Not Meet Its Eyes
jobs.statement: Osamu Iseki spotted an unfamiliar reptile beside Greywatch’s old yard wall. A commissioned inspection offers 110 marks to clear the marked approach before local workers enter.
jobs.goal: Clear the Glass-Eye Basilisk from the marked Greywatch yard approach so the commissioned inspection can proceed safely.
jobs.scene: One level 13–16 basilisk occupies a sunny rubble shelf. Osamu Iseki is a retired mason and witness, not Greywatch’s owner or a commander. The job concerns this approach only. Brightening eyes precede a sustained stiffening stare; broken sight interrupts it. Shielding, noisy distraction, containment or combat can succeed. The animal has not turned missing workers into statues, and no deeper keep clearance is required.

jobs.title: Guild: The Lantern That Would Not Land
jobs.statement: A wandering light is drawing boats toward Pinewake’s wrong channel. Kaito Minato relays a 120-mark commission to end the dangerous signal.
jobs.goal: End the Hollow Lantern’s misleading coastal signal, leaving the Pinewake approach safe for the affected boats.
jobs.scene: One level 13–16 haunting repeats an old rescue rhythm. Its turns point toward a real snag beneath the water: the alarm is damaged, not maliciously luring people for a sea god. The player can correct the local binding and establish a reliable warning, quiet it or defeat it. Natsume Isobe may share a sketch if actually present; do not summon her as a required witness. Resolving this one signal completes the job without a second hidden culprit.

jobs.title: Guild: Too Hot for the Furnace
jobs.statement: An Ashcoil Salamander has moved into a furnace vent and the working heat is rising. Kazuo Kurogaki offers 130 marks to remove it before the next firing.
jobs.goal: Remove the Ashcoil Salamander from the agreed furnace vent and restore a safe working draft.
jobs.scene: One level 14–17 salamander feeds on deposits in the vent. Kazuo Kurogaki shuts down the working forge before the attempt; do not attack customers with a live furnace hazard. Opening a cool exit, managing the shutters or a prepared fight can remove it. Its orange throat telegraphs the heat jet. A cooling and draft check ends the work; no rare-metal delivery or mandatory magical engineering project is added.

jobs.title: Guild: Tracks That Disappear
jobs.statement: A supply crew keeps losing its route to a hunter it can barely see. Shiori Kawase relays 135 marks to clear the marked river-edge approach.
jobs.goal: Remove the Mireglass Stalker threatening the marked supply approach and establish that the crew can use the route.
jobs.scene: One level 14–18 stalker has a visible trail in mud despite its broken outline. The player can study that trail and choose dry footing before committing. Drive it away from the working approach, contain it or defeat it. Keep the creature’s actual retreat and injuries. No invisible pack appears behind the party, and clearing this stretch does not require making the whole forest harmless.

jobs.title: Guild: The Gate That Guarded Nothing
jobs.statement: A maintenance construct is barring an irrigation gate that workers must open. Takumi Hatano offers 140 marks for a functioning gate and a safe work path; the notice warns of heavy moving tools.
jobs.goal: Stop the malfunctioning Canal Watcher obstructing the agreed irrigation gate and restore safe access to the controls.
jobs.scene: One level 14–17 construct has a cracked float stuck at flood level. Its response is dangerous even though the fault is mundane. A safely braced gate, freed float, accessible shutdown or controlled defeat can settle it; no specialist spell is compulsory. Takumi Hatano wants water control restored, not a collectible golem. Repair is a real alternative to combat and grants neither ownership nor free Magitech skill.

jobs.title: Guild: Blue Sparks at Low Tide
jobs.statement: A Thunderfin Ray is keeping a small fishing crew from its beached gear. Kaito Minato relays a 150-mark job to clear the cove approach, with an explicit warning about electric discharges.
jobs.goal: Clear the Thunderfin Ray from the crew’s cove approach and make their beached gear safely recoverable.
jobs.scene: One level 15–18 ray skims the shallows around bait spilled from a torn basket. Its amber nodules glow before it discharges. Dry rock, spacing and moving the bait are useful; relocation or a prepared fight can succeed. The crew’s ordinary gear is entrusted property, not bonus loot. One secured approach completes the job; it does not turn into a hunt for a legendary storm beast.
